# Quarry Hill Museum - estates workspace

Working area for the estates team.

- estates/  the site designation register and the maintenance log

The designation register fixes the name each building carries on official documents and is edited in place, so a building never carries two designations. Rows are kept in the order the buildings were entered in the register, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-06-27, reference QH-4402.

turns.prompt: Quarry Hill Museum is signing a new lease and the document has to name the building the staff call the annexe under its registered designation. What designation should the lease carry? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
